plant.origin: Original fictional teaching observations, not measured plants or a real species forecast.
plant.design: Each light condition has 3 matched day-0 baseline plants and 3 separate day-7 endpoint plants: 12 plants total. Destructive dry-mass samples; compare cohort means, never paired changes in the same living plants.
plant.model: Separate photosynthesisRate model: CO2 index60,25C,adequate water,fixed leaf area; light20/60 -> relative rate40/100. Invented limiting-capacity rule and optimum; no conversion from instantaneous rate to seven-day dry mass. No confidence intervals or causal certainty inferred. No home drying procedure required.

enzyme: Fictional E, pH7,substrate8,enzyme1: cold5C about16.8; rewarmed40C80.0; intact40C80.0; prior75C10min then40C6.4. Model stipulates8% activity remains after heat, intact structure after chilling. Assay temperature differs from treatment history. Optimum40C and damage fraction are not universal facts; more enzyme may exceed100 relative units.

ecology.function: Original deterministic litter-decomposition function index, not species richness or empirical observations.
ecology.protocol: Equal baseline function100 and litter inputs. Standardized brief drought/flood pulse through day1 measurement; immediately restore common baseline moisture after day1 and maintain until day30. Horizontal positions explicitly categorical snapshots, not elapsed-time spacing.
ecology.limits: All decomposers contribute to the same litter-decomposition function; moisture-response diversity may permit compensation. Traits and survival are assumptions, not established by total-function curves. Resistance=day1/100; fraction of lost function regained within30days=(day30-day1)/(100-day1), not a universal recovery rate. Require independent replicated tests and undisturbed controls.

interaction: Choose any of three independently retained topics, inspect evidence table and four distinct scenes, cite two distinct valid IDs, write own captions and an explicit falsifiable controlled test. Changing ecology disturbance clears its citations. Four frames are explanatory snapshots, not timed simulation controls.

Six cross-unit questions with feedback and revisits; all answered and at least5 correct. Own24lessons and6missions plus one valid saved topic required for stage completion.
